user.title: ZOTA Smart
user.description: Set up the connection to a ZOTA PO Smart v2 boiler.

data_description.name: Name of the boiler in Home Assistant.
data_description.port: TCP port of the boiler LAN module (TLS-PSK).
data_description.proxy: Enabled — reach the official ZOTA cloud through a bridge.
data_description.cloud_address: ZOTA cloud address in host:port format.
data_description.psk: Module TLS-PSK key: 64 hex characters (32 bytes).
data_description.power_kw: Boiler power: 3–30 kW in steps of 3. Defines power presets (P/3, 2P/3, P).
data_description.serial: Optional: module serial number (for future use).
data_description.frame_log: Write all frames to /config/zota_frames.log. Off by default: the log grows continuously (20 MB rotation).

error.invalid_cloud_address: Please provide a cloud address in host:port format.
error.invalid_psk: PSK must be 64 hex characters (32 bytes).
error.invalid_power_kw: Power must be between 3 and 30 kW.
error.invalid_power_kw_step: Power must be a multiple of 3 kW (Smart family).

abort.already_configured: A boiler with this name is already configured.
